founder_directive: Integrate men and women in the official Signature scene edit: Bay Bridge shirt-and-shorts, Stay Golden shirt-and-shorts, and the Windbreaker Set.
founder_scene_direction_approval: Approved: Signature's two hero-derived world moments and The Departure Terrace are the official scene directions. This approval does not promote any generated product candidate or waive source/matte/native-integration review.

official_environment.visual_check: Oakland-side Bay Bridge waterfront/pier, daytime, bridge and skyline visible; founder-directed scene plate.
official_environment.use_rule: Preserve as the exact environment plate for the later protected composite. Never replace with generic San Francisco, Golden Gate, or a regenerated waterfront.

detail_locks: White tee with the exact centered blue/cyan Bay Bridge rose embroidery; no text.
White mesh knee-length shorts with continuous daytime Bay Bridge/city/water sublimation, blue waistband, white drawstring, and lower wearer-left blue rose/cloud.
Never exchange this blue daytime Bay Bridge palette for the purple Stay Golden palette.
White tee with the exact large centered purple/violet rose-and-Golden-Gate embroidery; no text.
White mesh knee-length shorts with continuous purple/violet Golden Gate and city-light print, purple waistband, white drawstring, and lower wearer-left purple rose.

Pink hood; pastel pink, lavender, mint, and yellow sewn chevrons; pink pocket piping; white zipper and drawstrings; multicolor cuff/hem/waist bands; small pink rose marks.

source_stage_script.required_frame: One full-body mixed adult cast: one man in sg-baybridge-set, one woman in sg-staygolden-set, and one woman in the complete sg-015 windbreaker set.
source_stage_script.camera: straight-on editorial 50mm-equivalent, full bodies and every short/hem/waistband visible, enough separation to inspect the five products independently.
source_stage_script.background: neutral warm-grey studio only for this source-stage candidate; no city, bridge, product text, signage, or environment.
source_stage_script.interaction: natural connected group, not a catalog row: Bay Bridge wearer takes one relaxed forward step, Stay Golden wearer shares a real sightline, windbreaker wearer forms the central connection; no occlusion of embroidery, waistbands, bridge prints, or chevrons.
prohibited: product-name text, captions, labels, or invented logos
separate jacket or pants sold as an invented sg-015 SKU
cropped legs, concealed waistbands, or unreadable product fronts

scene_stage_script_after_authority_pass.environment: Use the hash-bound Oakland Bay Bridge plate exactly; place the approved protected cast on the pier plane, keeping the foreground sketch crate unobstructed.
scene_stage_script_after_authority_pass.integration: Shared warm upper-right key light, soft shadows cast to viewer-left, Bay-water reflection response, correct plank-plane foot contact, soft atmospheric depth, real mutual sightline and minor occlusion.
scene_stage_script_after_authority_pass.forbidden: No independent redraw of garments, no generic waterfront, no Golden Gate scene, no product swapping, no text overlay inside the generated image.
